retrotech.title: RetroTech
retrotech.meta_description: RetroTech is the HeroHubs series on the technologies that shaped computing and still run in production, from mainframes and AS/400 to the languages and protocols behind them.
retrotech.intro: A series about the technologies that came before us and are still very much with us: mainframes, AS/400, COBOL, protocols and ideas that keep running in production. Each article looks at where they came from, why they lasted so long and what modernising them really means today.
retrotech.empty_title: The first episode is on its way
retrotech.empty_text: RetroTech has just started. Subscribe to the series feed to read the first article as soon as it is published, or browse the rest of the blog in the meantime.
